verdict.rationale: Make's docs show event-driven automation: webhooks create URLs that external apps or other scenarios call to trigger scenario execution [make-docs-15, make-docs-25]. Incoming webhook data can also be queued and processed on a schedule [make-docs-6, make-docs-21], and scenarios can be scheduled [make-docs-26]. Missing for 10: evidence of conditional rule logic (filters, routers, or conditions deciding which actions fire), documentation of native app-event triggers beyond webhooks, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
